sentences.text: The genus Unquillosaurus contains only one species, U. ceibalii, known solely from a single fossilized pubis bone.
The holotype specimen PVL 3670-11 was discovered at Arroyo-Morterito in the Los Blanquitos Formation dating to the Maastrichtian.
The type species Unquillosaurus ceibalii was described by Jaime Eduardo Powell in 1979.
In 2024, researchers considering the taxonomy of Diuqin, a genus of dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur, suggested Unquillosaurus might be a member of the Unenlagiinae.
